input.quote: For personal information processed by IBM on your behalf as part of the Services, IBM will act in accordance with your instructions by following such processing and security obligations as are contained in this Agreement.
input.rationale: Searches for "insurance" and coverage/certificate language return nothing, and the candidate sections confirm the gap: § 5.3 (Security) addresses only security features and disclaimers, § 14.12 (Risk of Loss) allocates risk between Base Components and Customer Components without requiring any policy, and § 14.18 confirms IBM processes personal information on our behalf as a hosting provider. With no insurance obligation at all for a vendor that hosts our environment and processes personal data, the clause is missing and sits in walk-away territory. We insert a single short clause in the miscellaneous section at the preferred level (CGL USD 1M per occurrence / USD 2M aggregate, E&O USD 2M, cyber and privacy USD 5M where IBM handles data belonging to, supplied by, or processed for Customer, statutory workers' compensation, certificates on request), drafted with a comprehensive data descriptor because "Customer Data" is not a defined term in this Agreement. The fallback (E&O USD 1M / cyber USD 2M) remains available.

proposal.summary: Insert a vendor insurance clause in the miscellaneous section (CGL 1M/2M, E&O 2M, cyber 5M where IBM processes our data, workers' compensation, certificates on request).
proposal.comment: [Playbook] The Agreement contains no insurance obligation even though IBM hosts our environment and processes personal information on our behalf, so we have added a short standard coverage clause (CGL USD 1M/2M, E&O USD 2M, cyber USD 5M where our data is involved, statutory workers' compensation, certificates on request). We can fall back to E&O USD 1M and cyber USD 2M if the higher limits are an issue.

ops.text: Insurance. IBM shall maintain commercial general liability insurance of not less than USD 1,000,000 per occurrence and USD 2,000,000 in the aggregate; professional liability (errors and omissions) insurance of not less than USD 2,000,000; where IBM processes, stores, or has access to any data belonging to, supplied by, or processed for Customer, cyber and privacy liability insurance of not less than USD 5,000,000; and workers' compensation insurance as required by law. IBM shall provide certificates of insurance to Customer on request.

mappings.element: Commercial general liability coverage is at least USD 1,000,000 per occurrence.
Commercial general liability coverage is at least USD 2,000,000 in the aggregate.
Professional errors and omissions coverage is at least USD 2,000,000.
If Vendor processes Customer Data, cyber and privacy coverage is at least USD 5,000,000.
Vendor maintains workers' compensation coverage as required by law.
Vendor provides certificates of insurance on request.
